body.p: The mammoth. Long ago, there were very many mammoths, they were many at the shore of the Arctic Sea(?). The mammoths made everything. Where the mammoths were walking, they made rivers. They pressed the earth with their feet, then rivers emerged. Where the mammoths were sleeping, there lakes emerged. So the mammoths damaged the world. The spirit Majin got angry, he killed the mammoths. There are such stories.
